integrity: The exact all-direction assertions follow from a self-contained analytic proof. Numerical checks are finite supporting evidence, not a proof of universal statements or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The global optimal three-ball radius is unknown; the exact radius sqrt(21)/8 belongs to the displayed explicit configuration only. The covering theorem applies to the embedded projective Veronese surface, not its convex hull. The common-isotropic-vector lemma is classical in the guise of Brickman convexity. title: Two-center rigidity and a sharp three-center escape for the Veronese projector surface
